description: This file defines the ParameterCrossReference class, which maps specific Parameter enum instances to their corresponding string descriptions related to vehicle parameters. It provides a constructor to initialize this mapping and a method to retrieve the description for a given Parameter.

classes.name: ParameterCrossReference
classes.description: A class that maintains a mapping from Parameter enum instances to their descriptive string labels specific to vehicle information parameters.

methods.name: ParameterCrossReference
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with specific Parameter to String mappings.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string label associated with the provided Parameter instance.
